definitions.gloss: boarding a ship; embarkation; getting on a boat
definitions.explanation: The act of getting on a ship or boat. Used for ferries, cruise ships, and other watercraft.

examples.japanese: {乗船|じょうせん}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To go through the boarding procedures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一時間前|いちじかんまえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗船|じょうせん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please board the ship at least one hour before departure.

examples.japanese: {乗船|じょうせん}{券|けん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{込|こ}んだ→乗り込む：04618_norikomu⟧。
examples.english: After showing my boarding pass, I boarded the ship.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word for boarding a ship. The opposite is ⟦{下船|げせん}→下船：21593_gesen⟧ (disembarking). Similar compounds exist for other vehicles: ⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧ (boarding a train/car), ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧ (boarding a plane).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗船|じょうせん}{券|けん} (boarding pass for a ship)
- {乗船|じょうせん}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (boarding procedures)
- {乗船|じょうせん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (boarding time)
- {乗船|じょうせん}⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧ (passenger list)
